question: An air traffic controller needs to control the landing times of n aircrafts: Flights must land in the order 1, ..., n. Flight j must land in time interval [aj , bj ]. n = 10. [a1, b1] = [0, 60], [a2, b2] = [10, 70], [a3, b3] = [20,80], [a4, b4] = [30, 90], [a5, b5] = [40, 100], [a6, b6] = [50, 110], [a7, b7] = [60, 120], [a8, b8] = [70, 130], [a9, b9] = [80, 140], [a10, b10] = [90, 150]. The objective is to maximize the minimum separation time, which is the interval between two landings. Find the maximal minimum separation. Provide your answer rounded to the nearest time.

candidates.code:
import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "n": 10,
    "a": {1: 0, 2: 10, 3: 20, 4: 30, 5: 40,
          6: 50, 7: 60, 8: 70, 9: 80, 10: 90},
    "b": {1: 60, 2: 70, 3: 80, 4: 90, 5: 100,
          6: 110, 7: 120, 8: 130, 9: 140, 10: 150},
}

GOLD_ANSWER = None


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    n = d["n"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.J = pyo.RangeSet(1, n)
    model.PAIRS = pyo.RangeSet(1, n - 1)

    def t_bounds(m, j):
        return (d["a"][j], d["b"][j])

    model.t = pyo.Var(model.J, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=t_bounds)

    model.S = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    def sep_rule(m, j):
        return m.t[j + 1] - m.t[j] >= m.S

    model.sep = pyo.Constraint(model.PAIRS, rule=sep_rule)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.S, sense=pyo.maximize)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "n": 10,
    "a": {1: 0,  2: 10, 3: 20, 4: 30, 5: 40,
          6: 50, 7: 60, 8: 70, 9: 80, 10: 90},
    "b": {1: 60, 2: 70, 3: 80, 4: 90, 5: 100,
          6: 110, 7: 120, 8: 130, 9: 140, 10: 150},
}

GOLD_ANSWER = None


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    n = d["n"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Flights 1..n, in fixed landing order
    model.J = pyo.RangeSet(1, n)
    # Consecutive pairs whose separation we constrain
    model.PAIRS = pyo.RangeSet(1, n - 1)

    # t[j] = landing time of flight j, within [a_j, b_j]
    def t_bounds(m, j):
        return (d["a"][j], d["b"][j])

    model.t = pyo.Var(
        model.J, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=t_bounds
    )

    # S = the minimum separation to be maximised
    model.S = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Each consecutive pair separated by at least S
    def sep_rule(m, j):
        return m.t[j + 1] - m.t[j] >= m.S

    model.sep = pyo.Constraint(model.PAIRS, rule=sep_rule)

    # Maximise the minimum separation
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.S, sense=pyo.maximize)

    return model

DATA = {

    "S_min": 1.0,      # lowercase bound on separation

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    n = d["n"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.J = pyo.RangeSet(1, n)
    model.PAIRS = pyo.RangeSet(1, n - 1)

    def t_bounds(m, j):
        return (d["a"][j], d["b"][j])

    model.t = pyo.Var(model.J, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=t_bounds)

    model.S = pyo.Var(
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=(d["S_min"], d["S_max"]),
    )

    def sep_rule(m, j):
        return m.t[j + 1] - m.t[j] >= m.S

    model.sep = pyo.Constraint(model.PAIRS, rule=sep_rule)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.S, sense=pyo.maximize)
